description: Empirical tight-binding (ETB) parameters for cubic CsPbI3 in the Jancu-Scholz-Beltram-Bassani sp3d5s* nearest-neighbour Slater-Koster scheme (PRB 57, 6493 (1998)). Cs is dropped from the basis (following Boyer-Richard et al.); only the cation c=Pb and anion a=I sublattices are kept. The unit cell contains 1 Pb + 3 I (one halide on each cubic axis), octahedral coordination, nearest-neighbour Pb-I bonds of length a/2 along the cubic axes. Each atom carries an sp3d5s* basis (10 orbitals) plus spin (x2). Spin-orbit coupling is included via the on-site p (and the convention's) Delta/3 parameters.

source.title: Tight-binding description of inorganic lead halide perovskites in cubic phase
source.dft_reference: WIEN2k, modified Becke-Johnson XC potential (Tran-Blaha) in Jishi parametrization
method_references: J. C. Slater and G. F. Koster, Phys. Rev. 94, 1498 (1954)
J.-M. Jancu, R. Scholz, F. Beltram, F. Bassani, Phys. Rev. B 57, 6493 (1998)
S. Boyer-Richard et al., J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 7, 3833 (2016) [starting parameters, ref. 12]

structure.coordination: PbI6 octahedron; nearest-neighbour Pb-I along +/- x, y, z at distance a/2

verification_targets.comment: Values stated explicitly in the paper text; used as V&V acceptance criteria.
verification_targets.dft_band_gap_R_eV_source: Sec. II: 'for the band gap we obtain the value Eg = 1.017 eV'
verification_targets.experiment_source: Sec. V, after Yuan et al. (ref. 35): peaks at 1.65 (R), 2.75 (M), 3.40 (X) eV
verification_targets.SO_splitting_source: Sec. V: 'the spin-orbit splitting of the conduction band in R point is 1.48 eV'
verification_targets.experimental_cubic_gap_source: Yuan et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 124, 8008 (2020), ref. 35

parameter_key_convention.naming: Subscripts a = anion (I), c = cation (Pb). Orbital labels: s, s* (second s, 's*'), p, d. Two-centre Slater-Koster integrals are named <orb1><orb2><bond> e.g. 'sapcsigma' = (s on anion)-(p on cation) sigma integral; 'scpasigma' = (s on cation)-(p on anion) sigma. On-site energies: E<orb><atom>, e.g. 'E_s_a' = on-site s energy on anion.
parameter_key_convention.spin_orbit: Delta_a/3 and Delta_c/3 are the listed spin-orbit parameters for anion and cation p-orbitals (lambda = Delta/3 enters the L.S matrix on p-orbitals).

zeroed_integrals.comment: Stated in Table I caption: these integrals are set to zero in all parameter sets.

sp3.description: Minimal sp3 model (no d, no s*). Fits DFT band structure (Fig. 1). SOC taken from the sp3d5s* fit.

sp3d5sstar.description: Full sp3d5s* nearest-neighbour model fit to DFT band structure (Fig. 2). Reproduces DFT R-point gap (1.017 eV) and the high-symmetry-point energies to meV precision.

experiment_corrected.description: sp3d5s* parameters revised to reproduce experimental band gaps (R: 1.65 eV, M: 2.75 eV). Recommended for nanostructure calculations to be compared with experiment. Differs from the 'sp3d5sstar' set only in a few integrals (E_p_c, sa_pc_sigma, sstar_a_pc_sigma, sstar_c_pa_sigma, pp_sigma, pp_pi).
